description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `a-number-that-is-a-sentence.json` is refused by `policy`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `policy`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `window`, a case that fired another check.
